description: List the live preview sites you created with a given project_key (your cross-session identity). Reuse one project_key across several named publishes, then call this to enumerate + manage them all. Returns structuredContent { status, count, sites:[{ name, url, expires_at, last_published, claimed }] }.

project_key.description: The secret project_key you published with (>=16 chars). Lists every live preview that shares it.

name: list_my_previews
title: List my previews
